name: The Mirror Maze of Liquid Light
description: An intricate maze composed of reflective surfaces that channel streams of liquid light, creating endless corridors that change color.

caption: Navigate a world where light itself becomes the path. Every turn reveals a new hue. 🌈🗺️ #MirrorMaze #LiquidLight #LabyrinthOfLight
